## Services & Pricing (ILS)
Three packages, all starting prices excluding VAT — final price depends on vehicle size:
- Polish & Nano: from ₪2,500 + VAT (the 2-step polish, finished with a nano ceramic coating for long-term protection; our flagship package, recommended for maximum shine and protection, including before selling a car)
- Polish & Wax: from ₪1,600 + VAT (the 2-step polish, plus a third step: protective wax layer)
- Polish: from ₪1,300 + VAT (2-step machine polish — cutting polish for correction, finishing polish for gloss)
